headword: アクション{映画|えいが}

definitions.explanation: A film genre built around fast-paced physical sequences such as fights, chases, and explosions.

examples.japanese: アクション{映画|えいが}が{好|す}きだ。
{週末|しゅうまつ}に{新|あたら}しいアクション{映画|えいが}を{見|み}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to see a new action movie over the weekend.

examples.japanese: このアクション{映画|えいが}は{迫力|はくりょく}のある{場面|ばめん}が{多|おお}くて{最後|さいご}まで{楽|たの}しめた。
examples.english: This action movie had many powerful scenes, so I enjoyed it all the way to the end.

notes:
アクション is a loanword from English "action"; combined with {映画|えいが} (movie) it names the genre.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アクション{映画|えいが}を{見|み}る: to watch an action movie
- {本格|ほんかく}アクション{映画|えいが}: a full-fledged action movie

SIMILAR WORDS:
- アクション: action — also used alone, e.g. アクションシーン (action scene)
- {特撮|とくさつ}{映画|えいが}: special-effects film — overlaps but emphasizes effects rather than physical action
